description: This file defines a Spring Data MongoDB repository interface for managing Document entities, providing CRUD operations and custom query methods based on ownerId, status, type, and tags.

classes.name: DocumentRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for Document entities extending MongoRepository, providing custom query methods.

methods.name: findByOwnerId
methods.description: Finds documents that belong to a specific owner, identified by ownerId.

methods.name: findByStatus
methods.description: Finds documents matching a specific status such as NEW, PROCESSING, or READY.

methods.name: findByType
methods.description: Finds documents of a certain type or category like RECEIPT or INVOICE.

methods.name: findByTagsContaining
methods.description: Finds documents that contain a specific tag.
